title: Expose a false admission even with faithful noncommuting outputs
statement: For an invertible matrix of normalized pure columns, congruence makes the one-family trace inverse form exactly the classical identity form for EVERY admitted Q,u and finite reference. This does not preserve Umegaki information. In the faithful0,+ continuation with r=4/5 and target binary signal2/3 the candidate all-level coefficient is17/18<1, but the explicit faithful input hypotheses have D_target>D_preparation. Thus matching that inverse form is insufficient to admit the proposed transfer.
